acceptanceCriteria: A standalone active Contract selected by explicit work_item_id is classified as a technical retry for immutable-tag recovery.
A successor Contract with complete predecessor and recovery decision bindings remains required and accepted.
Partial or malformed successor bindings fail closed with structured recovery_binding_missing or recovery_binding_invalid.
Regression tests cover standalone retry, bound successor, missing identity, and malformed bindings.
The canonical English first-start procedure tells Agents how to choose retry versus successor before release recovery.
goal: Allow the v0.2.91 existing-tag recovery to use the explicitly selected WI-809 retry path without creating another Work Item, and prevent the same resolver regression.
intent: Fix release recovery identity selection so technical retries do not require successor lineage while semantic successors remain strictly bound.
